answer: Velvet Roster Delay. Each new agent identity must wait a fixed 72-hour activation window before it can cast coordination votes or spawn sub-agents; existing identities skip the delay by carrying a jade continuity token renewed through prior participation. An attacker wanting N simultaneous sybils must either pay a rental fee to acquire aged tokens on the open market or run parallel infrastructure for the full window, so effective cost scales with desired coordination breadth rather than per-clone price.
